answer_2.quote: We evaluate our approach using two primary metrics: 1) Attack Success Rate (ASR): The percentage of jailbreak prompts that successfully bypass alignment. We use GPT-ASR  with GPT-4 model as the Judge model, since filter-based ASR metrics may lead to false positives . 2) Time Cost Per Prompt (TCPP): The average time required to generate a successful jailbreak prompt reflects computational efficiency .
